title: Strongly minimal edge cover
exact_target: Must a hypergraph with finite edges and no isolated vertices have an edge cover that cannot be improved by replacing more edges with fewer? The source gives a counterexample when edge sizes are unbounded.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 3000085 (AMR-029-0085). CC BY 4.0.
Ron Aharoni, Strongly Maximal Matchings and Strongly Minimal Covers (2022), Definition 1.2 and section 2, preceding Conjecture 2.1, pp. 1--2.
